versions.changelog:
- Added an "Author" section at the end of the documentation, providing attribution and links to Canlah AI and related resources.
- No changes to usage, features, or core functionality. Documentation update only.

- Added comprehensive documentation describing usage, model selection, API endpoints, pricing, and strengths for both fal.ai and BytePlus Seedream backends.
- Introduced auto-selection logic with BytePlus Seedream as the default for cost efficiency and photo quality.
- Provided detailed script usage examples, including support for text-to-image, reference-guided generation, batch processing, and poster mode.
- Clarified backend/model aliases, aspect ratio recommendations for various platforms, and output conventions.
- Documented backend limitations, resolution tiers, and pricing, including advice for color/desaturation control per model.
